description:
**12 month lease***

Welcome to DX Living Donnybrook - Modern Studio Apartments for Rent in Dublin 4

Visit www.dxlivingdonnybrook.ie for more information 

Discover DX Living Donnybrook, an exciting new rental development of stylish studio apartments with extensive amenities designed for comfortable, urban living. Located in the heart of Donnybrook, one of Dublin’s most desirable areas, these studios combine contemporary style and convenience
.
What’s Included:

•	Studio Apartment - Your own space with double bed, ensuite bathroom, kitchenette with hob & fridge, and smart storage.

•	Inclusive Utilities - Electricity, water, heat, high-speed WiFi, and refuse included in rent.

•	Residents’ Amenities - Stunning lounges, co-working areas, communal kitchens, games room, rooftop garden, and bike storage.

•	Community - Join an exciting new community with shared spaces and interests.

•	On-site Concierge & Security

•	Flexible Lease Terms - Options starting from just 3 months.

•	Additional Services Available - Optional bed linen, plates, and cutlery for easy move-in.

Prime Location: DX Living is in vibrant Donnybrook, with local shops, cafes, and dining options nearby. Herbert Park is just steps away, perfect for outdoor activities, and Raw Gyms Donnybrook is next door. Donnybrook Mall and Donnybrook Fair are only a few minutes away, providing everyday essentials and gourmet groceries.

Convenient Transport: Bus routes including the E1, 39A, E2 and 11B offer quick connections to Dublin city centre (just 10 minutes). The Aircoach to Dublin Airport stops nearby every 30 minutes. Grand Canal Dock is only a 9-minute cycle away.

Starting at €1,750 per month, DX Living Donnybrook offers you stylish living, convenience, and community in Dublin 4. Contact us now to schedule a viewing!
